newsitem.title: USA: Unison to restate nine month results down.
newsitem.headline: Unison to restate nine month results down.

text.p: Unison HealthCare Corp said Tuesday is expects to restate its previously issued results for the nine months ended September 30, 1996, and it estimates that the restatement will have a negative impact on year-to-date results of approximately $5 to $6 million pre-tax, or $3 to $3.6 million after tax.
The company plans to announce more detailed information within one week and at that time expects to conduct a conference call with members of the investment community.
Unison said it expects that the announcement of financial results for the year ended December 31, 1996, will be delayed.
Although the company will request a 15-day extension for the filing of its annual report on Form 10-K, it said it is possible that such an extension may not be sufficient.
